options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: deviceRole
options.description: DeviceRole query parameter. CORE, ACCESS, DISTRIBUTION, ROUTER, WLC, or AP (case insensitive).

options.name: endTime
options.description: EndTime query parameter. UTC epoch time in milliseconds.

options.name: health
options.description: Health query parameter. Catalyst Center health catagory POOR, FAIR, or GOOD (case insensitive).

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Max number of device entries in the response (default to 50. Max at 500).

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The offset of the first device in the returned data (Mutiple of 'limit' + 1).

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId query parameter. Catalyst Center site UUID.

options.name: startTime
options.description: StartTime query parameter. UTC epoch time in milliseconds.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
